+@pytest.mark.parametrize('module', ['mod', 'mod.submod'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('prefix', ['', '.', '~'])
+def test_type_field_xrefs(app, module, prefix, warning):
+    warning.seek(0)
+    warning.truncate(0)
+    text = ('.. py:class:: mod.A\n\n'
+            '.. py:class:: mod.submod.A\n\n'
+            '.. py:currentmodule:: %s\n\n'
+            '.. py:function:: f()\n\n'
+            '   :param %sA a: description\n'
+            '   :type b: %sA\n'
+            '   :param b: description\n'
+            '   :rtype: %sA\n') % (module, prefix, prefix, prefix)
+    doctree = restructuredtext.parse(app, text)
+    domain = app.env.get_domain('py')
+    refs = list(doctree.traverse(pending_xref))
+    assert len(refs) == 3
+    for ref in refs:
+        resolved = domain.resolve_xref(app.env, 'index', app.builder,
+                                       ref['reftype'], ref['reftarget'], ref, ref[0])
+        assert resolved['reftitle'] == module + '.A'
+    assert warning.getvalue() == ''
+
+
 def test_parse_annotation(app):
